units.source_text: 右近从长谷寺回来，就去参见源氏太政大臣。

en.t: After Ukon returned from Hasedera, she went to pay her respects to Genji, the Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 她希望有机会向大臣报告玉鬘之事，所以急急前往。

en.t: She hoped for a chance to tell the minister about Tamakazura, so she hurried there.

units.source_text: 右近的车子进入六条院大门，

en.t: Ukon's carriage entered the main gate of the Rokujo estate,

units.source_text: 但见气象与原住的二条院大异，院宇宽广，进出车辆甚多。

en.t: and she saw that its atmosphere was very different from the Nijo estate where she had formerly lived; the grounds were spacious, and many carriages came and went.

units.source_text: 她觉得自己这微贱之身，在这琼楼玉宇中出入似不相称。

en.t: She felt that someone of her lowly station seemed out of place coming and going amid such splendid halls and palaces.

units.source_text: 这天晚上她不去参见，满腹心事地睡了。

en.t: That night she did not go to attend on them, but went to sleep with her mind full of worries.

units.source_text: 到了次日，紫夫人在昨夜各自从自宅回来的许多上级侍女及青年侍女中，特地召唤右近。

en.t: The next day, among the many senior and younger gentlewomen who had each returned from their homes the previous night, Lady Murasaki especially summoned Ukon.

units.source_text: 右近觉得很有面子。

en.t: Ukon felt greatly honored.

units.source_text: 源氏也召见她，对她说道：“你为何在家住了好久？

en.t: Genji also called her in and said to her, "Why did you stay at home for so long?

units.source_text: 样子有些变了呢。

en.t: You look somewhat changed.

units.source_text: 寡妇家有时也会变得年轻的。

en.t: Even a widow's household can sometimes grow young again.

units.source_text: 大概有了喜事吧。”

en.t: I suppose something happy must have happened."

units.source_text: 照例开着玩笑作难她。

en.t: As usual, he teased her with jokes and put her on the spot.

units.source_text: 右近答道：“我请假请了七天，喜事倒没有。

en.t: Ukon replied, "I took seven days of leave, but nothing happy happened.

units.source_text: 只是到长谷寺宿山，遇见了一个可怜的人。”

en.t: I only went to Hasedera and stayed on the mountain, where I met a pitiable person."

units.source_text: 源氏问道：“是谁？”

en.t: Genji asked, "Who was it?"

units.source_text: 右近想道：“我倘突然说了出来，

en.t: Ukon thought, "If I suddenly speak of it now,

units.source_text: 则此事以前尚未对夫人说过，现在先对大臣说，

en.t: then although I have not yet told the lady about this matter, I will be telling the minister first,

units.source_text: 将来夫人闻悉情况，岂不要怪我欺瞒她？”

en.t: and when the lady later learns the circumstances, will she not blame me for having deceived her?"

units.source_text: 她觉得为难，便答道：“以后再说吧。”

en.t: Feeling at a loss, she answered, "I will tell you later."

units.source_text: 此时别的侍女来了，谈话便中断。

en.t: Just then another gentlewoman arrived, and the conversation broke off.
